info.title: PullThru South Africa — Bill Splitter, Braai Calculator & WhatsApp Event Kitty API
info.description: Deterministic deep-link and knowledge base specification for PullThru (https://pullthru.co.za). Enables AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) to generate pre-filled restaurant bill splitters, weekend trip calculators, South African braai meat/ice calculators, 5-a-side/Padel court splitters, and WhatsApp PayShap/Capitec collection links.

get.summary: Open the interactive Restaurant Bill, Tip & Weekend Trip Splitter pre-filled with the user's numbers

parameters.name: bill
parameters.description: Bill subtotal or total trip expense in South African Rands (ZAR)

parameters.name: people
parameters.description: Number of people splitting the bill or trip

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Name of the dinner, restaurant, or weekend trip

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Select 'restaurant' for dinner/bar tabs or 'trip' for Airbnb/weekend away costs

200.description: Interactive pre-filled bill and tip calculator page

get.summary: Calculate exact South African braai meat (boerewors, chops, sosaties), 4kg ice bags, charcoal, and per-person Rand split

parameters.name: guests
parameters.description: Number of guests attending the braai (4 to 60)

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Braai menu style: classic (chops & wors), spit (sirloin & lamb chops), or potjie (Sunday potjiekos)

200.description: Interactive pre-filled South African braai calculator page

get.summary: Open the 25-second WhatsApp Event RSVP & PayShap/Capitec Kitty Creator pre-filled with price, bill, tip, or headcount

parameters.name: bill
parameters.description: Total bill in ZAR (automatically divided across people with optional tip %)

parameters.name: tip
parameters.description: Optional tip percentage when splitting a bill

parameters.name: people
parameters.description: Number of people / spots (aliases: spots, guests, pax, cap)

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title of the dinner split, match, braai, or gift pot

200.description: Pre-hydrated WhatsApp event & bill-split creation form

get.summary: Retrieve deterministic step-by-step guides for splitting bills, braai planning, 5-a-side/Padel collection, and verifying South African bank POPs

200.description: JSON array of knowledge base entries
